018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.format;
021import static java.lang.String.join;
022import static javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR;
023import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
024import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
025import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.first;
026
027import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
028import java.util.ArrayList;
029import java.util.List;
030import java.util.regex.Pattern;
031import java.util.regex.PatternSyntaxException;
032
033import org.apiguardian.api.API;
034import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
035import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
036import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
037import com.sun.source.doctree.UnknownInlineTagTree;
038
039/**
040 *  <p>{@summary This inline tag inserts an HTML anchor into the documentation
041 *  that can be used for references to the location of that anchor.} It can be
042 *  used as this:</p>
043 *  <pre><code>&hellip; {&#64;anchor #&lt;<i>anchor</i>&gt; &lt;<i>text</i>&gt;} &hellip;</code></pre>
044 *  <p>That allows to reference the &lt;text&gt; by the anchor &lt;anchor&gt;
045 *  like this:</p>
046 *  <pre><code>&hellip; &lt;a href=&quot;#anchor&quot;&gt;&hellip;&lt;/a&gt; &hellip;</code></pre>
047 *  <p>Or, with the {@code href} tag:</p>
048 *  <pre><code>&hellip; {&#64;href #anchor &hellip;}</code></pre>
049 *  <p>The hash symbol (&quot;#&quot;) before the anchor name is mandatory!</p>
050 *  <p>&lt;text&gt; will be written to the output as is; that means that HTML
051 *  tags will work, but Javadoc tags are not parsed properly.</p>
052 *
053 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
054 *  @version $Id: AnchorTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
055 *  @since 0.0.5
056 *
057 *  @see HRefTaglet
058 */
059@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: AnchorTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
060@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
061public final class AnchorTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
062{
063        /*-----------*\
064    ====** Constants **========================================================
065        \*-----------*/
066    /**
067     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
068     */
069    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "anchor";
070
071        /*------------------------*\
072    ====** Static Initialisations **===========================================
073        \*------------------------*/
074    /**
075     *  <p>{@summary The pattern for the tag.}</p>
076     */
077    private static final Pattern PATTERN;
078
079    static
080    {
081        try
082        {
083            PATTERN = Pattern.compile( "#(?<name>.*?) (?<contents>.*)" );
084        }
085        catch( final PatternSyntaxException e )
086        {
087            throw new ExceptionInInitializerError( e );
088        }
089    }
090
091        /*--------------*\
092    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
093        \*--------------*/
094    /**
095     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code AnchorTaglet} instance.}</p>
096     */
097    public AnchorTaglet()
098    {
099        super( TAGLET_NAME, true, Location.values() );
100    }   //  AnchorTaglet()
101
102        /*---------*\
103    ====** Methods **==========================================================
104        \*---------*/
105    /**
106     *  {@inheritDoc}
107     */
108    @Override
109    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
110    {
111        final List<String> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
112        for( final var tag : tags )
113        {
114            if( tag instanceof UnknownInlineTagTree inlineTagTree )
115            {
116                final var arguments = processTagContent( inlineTagTree.getContent(), element );
117                final var matcher = PATTERN.matcher( arguments );
118                if( matcher.matches() )
119                {
120                    final var id = matcher.group( "name" );
121                    final var contents = processTagContent( parseText( matcher.group( "contents" ) ), element );
122                    buffer.add( format( "<a id=\"%2$s\">%1$s</a>", contents, id ) );
123                }
124            }
125            else
126            {
127                printf( ERROR, "Cannot process tag of '%s' (class '%s'): %s", tag.getKind().name(), tag.getClass().getName(), first( 20, tag.toString() ) );
128            }
129        }
130        final var retValue = join( EMPTY_STRING, buffer );
131
132        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
133        return retValue;
134    }   //  toString()
135}
136//  class AnchorTaglet
137
